While artificial intelligence has tremendous upside, it also can be used by bad actors to exploit citizens, including our most vulnerable—children. As technology improves, law enforcement must also adapt to advancements and changes. 

I, along with my colleagues, am proud to support the Child Exploitation and Artificial Intelligence Expert Commission Act of 2024 to protect children.

https://t.co/fTYVuNVYzE

The rapid rise of artificial intelligence has made it easier for predators to impersonate and target teens online. Today, Congress took action to hold these monsters accountable and empower victims to take back control. 

Thank you @FLOTUS for your passionate support and work on this important issue. Glad to see the TAKE IT DOWN Act pass the Senate and House and head to the president’s desk to become law ✅

As a mom of a school-age kid and part of the first generation of parents confronting the dangers that AI and social media pose to our kids, I’m passionate about how we protect them.

AI has become the wild, wild west. Companies are racing to push out new technology—at best to help in areas like healthcare and education, and at worst to chase profit while ignoring the real harm it can cause to children. Today, parents face a new and growing threat—predators that aren’t even human.

It's time to protect our kids.

No one should have their voice, image, or likeness stolen and used in a fake video or AI-generated deepfake without their consent. With artificial intelligence advancing at a rapid pace, it is becoming harder for people to know what is real and what is not. As a former Attorney General, I know predators will use any tool to target and deceive victims, and the NO FAKES Act gives Americans a way to fight back and hold scammers accountable.

As a mom, one of my top concerns is the impact AI is having on our children—especially as the technology becomes more ingrained in daily life.

We cannot allow Congress to stall, cross its fingers, and hope that everything pans out for the best, because the dark side of AI is being utilized to scam seniors, facilitate addictive algorithms, and steal the images and likenesses of our children.
